PERSONAL.NATIONALITY: Cuban · residence and work permit in Spain
PERSONAL.SUMMARY: Engineer/Developer with 8 years of professional experience, specialized in full-stack development and data engineering. Advanced knowledge of Python (Django, FastAPI) and Java, with experience in web development, ERP (Odoo), desktop applications, and frontend development with Angular. Strong background in relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQLite), automation with Bash/PL/SQL, orchestration with Docker, and version control with Git/GitHub, with solid experience in Linux and Windows environments. I complement my professional career with personal projects that strengthen my Big Data and MLOps profile: development of classifiers and pipelines with PySpark/Spark MLlib, model lifecycle management with MLflow, deployment of predictive APIs with FastAPI, and continuous integration automation with GitHub Actions.
